title: Cloud Code expands skill library #cloudcode #aiskills #github
description:
Cloud Code gained a free library of 380+ skills on GitHub that expand what the AI can do inside a project. These skills function like apps, giving Cloud new jobs such as writing, coding, planning, and brainstorming.

The library includes contributed tools from teams at Google, Vercel, and Stripe, along with packs that add commands and built-in AI agents. The setup is simple: copy the files into your project, and Cloud immediately picks up new capabilities.

The broader significance is modular AI customization. Instead of building workflows from scratch, developers can plug in reusable skills to speed up execution, standardize tasks, and turn Cloud Code into a more flexible, specialized productivity layer.
